title: Is the CUR's face laid out as drawn: the hazard button beside the …
ask: Is the CUR's face laid out as drawn: the hazard button beside the winks, the screen knob below it, the stick on the far side?
why: The CUR (right of the wheel since D-586) now carries the hazard button (D-589) and the screen knob (D-581) as well as the two winks, the hatch and fuel-door keys and the mirror stick. Where each sits on its face is how the dash looks and how it falls to hand, so it is yours. The board is drawn now with one layout so the work can go on; it is not ordered until Y18, and moving things on it costs nothing but a redraw. What changes with your answer: the CUR's board and its mock-up's face openings (Y51), and the plate's width.
options:
(a) A third column between the keys and the stick: the hazard button top (in line with the two winks), the screen knob below it (in line with the hatch and fuel-door keys), the stick on the far side. The plate grows from 100 to 118 mm wide. This is what is drawn now.
(b) The hazard button and the screen knob both on the stick's side of the plate, the stick in the middle: the same width, the knob nearest the Display Unit.
(c) Something else: describe it, or mark it on the CUR's mock-up in the app.
recommend: (a), unless you want the knob nearer the Display Unit - then (b)
stops: nothing now; the CUR's face openings in its mock-up (Y51) follow the answer, and the plate is redrawn only if it is not (a)
